summary: Local HTTP/WebRTC bridge contract for WhatsApp Calling and voice streaming experiments.

completed_voice_note.use: WhatsApp voice notes and other upload paths that need an Ogg/Opus file.

streamed_voice_note.use: Smoke tests or integrations that want Ogg/Opus encoded from daemon PCM frames without a WAV intermediate.

raw_outbound_pcm.use: Outbound WebRTC sidecar audio; stdout contains headerless fixed-size PCM frames.

raw_inbound_pcm.use: Inbound WebRTC sidecar audio after RTP/Opus has been decoded to local PCM.

file_transcription_smoke.use: Testing the inbound stream-transcribe contract from WAV, Ogg/Opus, or another audio file.

health.description: Return process health, active call IDs, and the fixed audio shape.

offer.description: Create or replace a call session from a remote SDP offer and return a local SDP answer.

call_status.description: Inspect a live call session and queue depths.

query.max_bytes: Positive byte count aligned to whole s16le samples. Defaults to audio.default_drain_bytes and is capped by audio.max_inbound_queue_bytes.
query.wait_ms: Optional non-negative long-poll timeout. Capped by audio.max_drain_wait_ms.

receive_audio.description: Drain decoded inbound PCM from a live call session.

send_audio.description: Queue outbound PCM for a live call session.

clear_audio.description: Drop queued outbound PCM for a live call session without closing the call. Use this for barge-in or call-turn cancellation.

close_call.description: Close and remove a live call session.

offer_request.call_id: Required call session identifier from the WhatsApp Calling webhook.
offer_request.type: Required SDP type. v1 accepts offer.
offer_request.sdp: Required remote SDP offer from WhatsApp. remote_sdp is accepted as an alias by the Python sidecar.

offer_response.sdp: Local SDP answer to pass unchanged to WhatsApp pre_accept and accept actions.
offer_response.audio: Full fixed audio contract object defined by audio.
offer_response.state: Current call_state object after local SDP answer creation.

call_state.closed: Whether the local sidecar session has been closed.
call_state.ready_for_accept: Whether the sidecar has created a local SDP answer, attached a live outbound audio track, completed ICE gathering, and is ready for Hermes to send the WhatsApp accept action.
call_state.readiness: Per-condition readiness booleans backing ready_for_accept: not_closed, local_sdp_answer, signaling_stable, ice_gathering_complete, and outbound_audio_track.
call_state.tasks: Number of active background media tasks owned by the session.
call_state.queued_tx_bytes: Outbound PCM bytes queued for WebRTC transmission.
call_state.queued_tx_ms: Approximate outbound PCM duration queued for WebRTC transmission, rounded up to whole milliseconds.
call_state.max_tx_queue_bytes: Maximum outbound PCM bytes this sidecar will queue for one call.
call_state.max_tx_queue_ms: Maximum outbound PCM duration this sidecar will queue for one call, rounded up to whole milliseconds.
call_state.queued_rx_bytes: Inbound decoded PCM bytes queued for Hermes to drain.
call_state.queued_rx_ms: Approximate inbound decoded PCM duration queued for Hermes to drain, rounded up to whole milliseconds.
call_state.max_rx_queue_bytes: Maximum inbound decoded PCM bytes this sidecar will retain for one call.
call_state.max_rx_queue_ms: Maximum inbound decoded PCM duration this sidecar will retain for one call, rounded up to whole milliseconds.
call_state.audio: Full fixed audio contract object defined by audio.

payloads.call_status_response: The call_state object for the requested call_id.

close_call_response.closed: Always true when the close request succeeds.

send_audio_request.pcm_s16le_base64: Required base64 encoded signed 16-bit little-endian mono PCM.

send_audio_response.accepted_bytes: Number of outbound PCM bytes accepted into the per-call queue.
send_audio_response.accepted_ms: Approximate outbound PCM duration accepted into the per-call queue, rounded up to whole milliseconds.
send_audio_response.queued_tx_bytes: Outbound PCM bytes queued after this write.
send_audio_response.queued_tx_ms: Approximate outbound PCM duration queued after this write, rounded up to whole milliseconds.
send_audio_response.max_tx_queue_bytes: Maximum outbound PCM bytes this sidecar will queue for one call.
send_audio_response.max_tx_queue_ms: Maximum outbound PCM duration this sidecar will queue for one call, rounded up to whole milliseconds.
send_audio_response.audio: Full fixed audio contract object defined by audio.

clear_audio_response.dropped_tx_bytes: Number of queued outbound PCM bytes discarded.
clear_audio_response.dropped_tx_ms: Approximate queued outbound PCM duration discarded, rounded up to whole milliseconds.
clear_audio_response.queued_tx_bytes: Outbound PCM bytes queued after the clear operation, normally 0.
clear_audio_response.queued_tx_ms: Approximate outbound PCM duration queued after the clear operation, normally 0.
clear_audio_response.max_tx_queue_bytes: Maximum outbound PCM bytes this sidecar will queue for one call.
clear_audio_response.max_tx_queue_ms: Maximum outbound PCM duration this sidecar will queue for one call, rounded up to whole milliseconds.
clear_audio_response.audio: Full fixed audio contract object defined by audio.

receive_audio_response.returned_bytes: Number of decoded PCM bytes returned.
receive_audio_response.returned_ms: Approximate decoded PCM duration returned, rounded up to whole milliseconds.
receive_audio_response.queued_rx_bytes: Remaining inbound decoded PCM bytes queued after this drain.
receive_audio_response.queued_rx_ms: Approximate inbound decoded PCM duration queued after this drain, rounded up to whole milliseconds.
receive_audio_response.max_rx_queue_bytes: Maximum inbound decoded PCM bytes this sidecar will retain for one call.
receive_audio_response.max_rx_queue_ms: Maximum inbound decoded PCM duration this sidecar will retain for one call, rounded up to whole milliseconds.
receive_audio_response.pcm_s16le_base64: Base64 encoded signed 16-bit little-endian mono PCM.
receive_audio_response.audio: Full fixed audio contract object defined by audio.

error_response.error: Human-readable error message. Non-2xx responses use this shape.
